package.name: rca_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic simulation backend for the dependency-aware temporal RCA experiments. Provides the world, the differential-drive robot, the ros_gz bridge configuration, the ROS 2 sensor driver nodes (which also carry the runtime degradation layer) and the Gazebo scenario runner. The processing pipeline (perception / localization / planning / control) is reused verbatim from rca_sim, so both simulators feed the identical diagnostic monitor and RCA engine.
